{{Quote|Chsthiss.|Slis Tieeer Dualli, last words&mdash;"Goodbye" in the [[Kobothi]] language|<ref name="firefight" />}}
'''Slis Tieeer Dualli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kobok/Legends|Kobok]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was invited to be a part of a mercenary team, put together by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]], to hunt down and [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Having acquired a massive amount of riches thanks to his excellent piloting skills, Dualli spent most of his life seeking a way to cure his boredom&mdash;periodically shifting between piloting jobs and 'retirement'. Attracted by the prospects of a challenge, Dualli made his way to the third [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rinn/Legends|Rinn]], [[Iope]], hoping to be hired for a considerable sum. Unfortunately, Dualli was not up to muster. While being [[Skirmish on Iope|tested]] by X-7, Dualli was drawn towards a false firing position, and ultimately killed by X-7. Dualli's last-known ship was a [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|Cloakshape fighter]].<ref name="firefight" />
